externalDictionaryInspections.heading: 煎る（読み）イル
externalDictionaryInspections.dictionary: Digital Daijisen; Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten also inspected
externalDictionaryInspections.inspection: Actual fetched entry inspected. Daijisen covers reducing liquid until moisture is gone and heating ingredients in a pan; the bean example supports the roasting lesson. Its supplement warns against sharp spelling-based semantic divisions.
externalDictionaryInspections.limits: The initial search endpoint returned an irrelevant placeholder; that result is not evidence. A web-search summary's stronger always-without-oil rule is not supported by this inspected entry. Author retrieval is not independent reviewer retrieval.

externalDictionaryInspections.heading: 炒める（読み）イタメル
externalDictionaryInspections.dictionaryHeading: いた・める【×炒める／×煠める】
externalDictionaryInspections.dictionary: Digital Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten
externalDictionaryInspections.inspection: Actual linked entry fetched and inspected. Both definitions describe cooking vegetables/meat with a little oil. Daijisen's butter-and-vegetables example supports the oil-cooking comparison, not an absolute division between every いる spelling.
externalDictionaryInspections.limits: Dictionary-supported practical contrast, not an exhaustive taxonomy of cooking or a frequency measurement. Author retrieval is not independent reviewer retrieval.

externalDictionaryInspections.heading: インキとインクの違いとは？業界別の使い分けや語源を分かりやすく解説
inspectedSections: 結論としてインキとインクは同じものを指す
業界による慣習の違い
日常生活や文具およびプリンターではインクと呼ばれる
externalDictionaryInspections.sourceType: Printing-ink manufacturer's explanatory column; terminology expertise, not a general-language frequency corpus.
externalDictionaryInspections.inspection: Actual page fetched and inspected. It describes the same underlying material, traditional printing-industry インキ, and consumer stationery/home-printer インク conventions. It explicitly rejects a compositional boundary and says either label is not inherently erroneous.
externalDictionaryInspections.limits: Supports the qualified domain/consumer-label guidance only. Historical origin dates, viscosity divisions and measured relative frequency are not adopted. Search output contained inconsistent alternate URLs; only this actually fetched URL is evidence.

externalDictionaryInspections.heading: インキ
externalDictionaryInspections.inspection: Actual entry fetched and inspected. It says general インク is nearly the same meaning, printing convention traditionally uses インキ, and stationery/home-printer contexts often use インク.
externalDictionaryInspections.limits: Industry usage evidence, not a survey of all Japanese speech. The revised card does not label printer インキ ungrammatical, obsolete or impossible.
